evidenceRecords.metric: Above-ground dry-weight slope against cumulative intercepted PAR (radiation-use efficiency)

parameter.unit: g above-ground dry matter per MJ intercepted PAR
parameter.transcriptionTolerance: ±0.005 g/MJ, source-display rounding only; ±0.030 retained as reported and not interpreted as a confidence interval

evidenceRecords.method: Crop PAR interception was computed on a crop ground-cover basis. RUE is the slope of the regression of dry weight on cumulative intercepted PAR; source figure reports y = -1.82 + 2.71x, R² = 0.99. The RUE was not significantly affected by density in this experiment.
limitations: This value applies to above-ground dry matter, not whole-plant biomass or harvested marketable mass.
No source-independent generic canopy interception fraction/trajectory is supplied by this parameter record.
This parameter reference is not calibration evidence for a candidate and does not validate a prediction.
